note: e2e profiles (SPEC §13.5, D4 §8.11). Scenarios run in the listed order; disruptive reliability scenarios (kill, crash, auth) come last. gates: coverage = every Appendix B key and call mode per Revit year (e2e/coverage-exemptions.json), hints = W1/W2 over every call, t1 = output budgets (e2e/budgets.json) and p95 growth (e2e/t1-baseline.json). --only ignores this file (profile lane).

surface.description: No Revit (hosted CI, ~20 s): surface gates, eras, lenient input, and the offline weak-model and token checks.

quick.description: Real Revit, ~25 min per year: bootstrap, every domain once, the core reliability paths.

full.description: Real Revit on every given year (2024,2027): every scenario, the coverage gate over all 243 keys and 5 modes, hints and T1.

soak.description: Real Revit, long run (E2E_SOAK_MIN, default 30 min per year): a mixed read/write/capture/undo loop; no errors, stable latency and Revit memory.

codex.description: Codex CLI integration (V22): isolated CODEX_HOME with the revit block (codex mcp get/list), the installed config (read only), and, only with E2E_CODEX_EXEC=1, one codex exec real-model run per client version.

claude.description: Claude Code integration: claude mcp get (read only) and the 2025-11-25 era capture preset; the claude -p large-capture check (SPEC §12.4) runs only with E2E_CLAUDE_P=1 and is not approved yet.
